headline: Coca-Cola Andina Reports 7.5% Profit Growth in Q3
summary: Chilean bottler Coca-Cola Andina saw third-quarter profit rise 7.5% to $64 million, driven by strong sales volumes in Brazil and favorable currency effects.
why: Coca-Cola Andina is a significant regional beverage bottler. Earnings growth in emerging markets is a key metric for consumer sector investors.

impacts.name: Coca-Cola Andina
impacts.why: Profit growth typically supports equity valuation.
